svg.text: Startup Atlas Pre-Fetch, Multi-Tier Caching (0.01 deg / ~1.1 km Grid Keys), & In-Memory NumPy Fusion
TIER 1 — External APIs, Reference DB & Local Data Sources
MongoDB Atlas | NASA Earthdata | ISRIC | Open-Meteo
Auth: Earthdata Bearer token or /login; plus local *-results.csv
TIER 2 — Ingestion, Pre-Fetch & Multi-Tier Caching (0.01 deg Grid | Redis L1 + MongoDB L2)
pixel or API timeout; falls back
Defaults to flat LS=1.0 on fail.
TIER 3 — In-Memory Engine Structures (Zero-I/O Compute RAM | Layer 1 & Layer 2)
Enables pure-RAM fancy indexing across thousands of GA chromosomes.
Passed directly into run_layer1_regression() in RAM.
Layer 1 regression to calibrate budgets, erosion & heat stress.
